verdict.rationale: Braintrust's Go SDK documents that tracing is built on OpenTelemetry, so developers instrument their code with the standard OTel API rather than a proprietary one. However, the evidence never documents an OTLP ingest endpoint for sending traces from arbitrary OTel exporters, nor OTLP export of traces back out. Missing for 10: documented OTLP ingest endpoint/configuration, OTLP export or receive capability, OTel support beyond the Go SDK, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: Tracing is built on OpenTelemetry, so you trace your own code with the standard OpenTelemetry API.
Tracing records what your application does as spans you can inspect in Braintrust.
